title: Volunteer
description: Give time to CCD — garden days, markets, events, and block projects.
heroBody: Not ready to become a member? Volunteering is the most direct way to help build the block — at markets, garden days, events, and clean-ups.
heroAlt: Smiling youth volunteer kneeling among the community garden beds

cards.title: Garden & green space days
cards.body: Planting, cleanup, and upkeep at the Oasis and Memorial Garden.

cards.title: Markets & events
cards.body: Set up, welcome neighbors, and run the CCD table on market days.

cards.title: Block projects & clean-ups
cards.body: Hands-on work reclaiming lots and beautifying the corridor.
